question: Do published general-integer throughput results support assuming premium Intel packages have durable competitive customer value?
not_tested: Not realized CPU ASP, actual Intel profit, customer procurement, a matched proprietary experiment, or agentic-AI throughput.
known_before_data: AMD blog used2510 Intel6980P and2840 EPYC9755 and3230EPYC9965 inMarch2025 selected results.
CurrentIntel6980P ARK RCP13955 mentioned by collaborating agent.
selection: All available SPEC CPU2017 integer-rate base submissions for listed models, fullenabledcores and two enabledchips, publication on or before2026-11-05. Retain onechipseparately if useful. Screenallconfigurations; no best-result cherry picking.
aggregation: Show full count/range and vendor-level medians to reduce repeated-submission weighting. No confidence intervals or causal claims.
limitations: System memory,compiler,tuning and vendor selection affect results.
Cores and threads are not comparable units of application work.
Listprices differ from realized or contracted prices and exclude memory,licensing,power and migration.
Arm customchips lack comparablepublicpricing and are not represented.
CPU2026 is a different suite; never combine scores across suites.
decision: Use only if data quality and scope add investment-relevant evidence; otherwise retain as rejectedanalysis.
